verdict.rationale: Maritime is a platform for hosting AI agents, so built-in AI insights about a user's data (for example agents, builds or usage) is a fair question to ask of it. However, no evidence shows the product itself surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions. What the evidence does show is that users can deploy their own agents that produce digests, or point an agent at a migration runbook. Those are user-built agent behaviors, not a native insights feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
